{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Trump/GOP tax proposals modify the Estate Tax to allow more wealth to flow freely across generations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The proposed elimination of the estate tax would only benefit the top 0.2% of people who die every year and owe the tax – 2 people out of every 1000.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Most budget watchers estimate that the Republican tax cuts would deny the federal government over three to seven trillion dollars of revenue over the next ten years.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for a truly fair tax system that taxes the rich and corporations at levels comparable to other major post-industrial economies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Recognition that building a multi-racial coalition of working people, grounded in a revitalized and democratic trade union movement, is necessary to achieve fairness.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Defeating the Trump tax cuts for the rich and corporate America would be the first step towards achieving a fair tax system.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
